final_text:
- Compute total as the number of items after applying category filter
  - Return { items, total, page, limit } instead of the bare array
  - Ensure category filtering continues to work with pagination (pagination is applied after filtering)

What this means for the API
- GET /items now returns:
  - On success: { items: Item[], total: number, page: number, limit: number }
  - On invalid input: 400 with { error: string }
- Pagination respects category filter:
  - Example: /items?category=tools&page=2&limit=10
- Defaults if no query params provided:
  - { items: [...], total: 45, page: 1, limit: 20 }

Code diff recap
- File: src/routes/items.ts
- Core logic added:
  - Build filtered list with category
  - Parse and validate page/limit
  - Apply slice for pagination
  - Return pagination metadata

How to test quickly
- Default listing:
  - route("GET", "/items") should return { items, total: 45, page: 1, limit: 20 }
- Specific pagination:
  - route("GET", "/items?page=2&limit=10") returns items 11-20 of the filtered set, with total equal to the number of matching items
- Invalid inputs:
  - route("GET", "/items?page=0") -> 400 with { error: "invalid page" }
  - route("GET", "/items?limit=0") -> 400 with { error: "invalid limit" }
  - route("GET", "/items?page=abc") -> 400 with { error: "invalid page" }
  - route("GET", "/items?limit=abc") -> 400 with { error: "invalid limit" }

If you want, I can add a couple of tests to test/api.test.ts to cover these new pagination scenarios.
